title: Motors and Drivetrains
description: Drive a differential drive robot in simulation with MWLib. Learn your first Java (methods, variables, operators) while writing tank drive and arcade drive.

checkpoints.title: Your drive code
checkpoints.description: Robot.java declares its own variables and uses arithmetic for arcade drive from the left stick Y and right stick X.

checkpoints.title: Drives forward
checkpoints.description: Push the left stick forward (W) until both sides hit full speed.

checkpoints.title: Drives backward
checkpoints.description: Pull the left stick back (S) until the right side hits full reverse.

checkpoints.title: Turns in place
checkpoints.description: Push the right stick left or right (Arrow Left / Right) so one side drives forward and the other backward.
